mapper.sql: id, revision_id, agreement_code, agreement_type, scene, market, locale, brand_code, car_line_code, title, version, agreement_date, content_type, body, content_hash, sanitizer_version, source_draft_id, source_draft_version, frozen_by, frozen_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.revision_id, r.agreement_code, r.agreement_type, r.scene, r.market, r.locale, r.brand_code, r.car_line_code, r.title, r.version, r.agreement_date, r.content_type, r.body, r.content_hash, r.sanitizer_version, r.source_draft_id, r.source_draft_version, r.frozen_by, r.frozen_at FROM cms_agreement_revision r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cms_agreement_bundle b WHERE b.privacy_revision_id = r.revision_id OR b.user_revision_id = r.revision_id )
